| a9214043 | D5b other-report extraction, tranche 1 (11 included reports) | sonnet, high x91 | 91 | 131,077 | 341,721 | 338,734 | 16,144,290 |
Estimate stated before the D5b launch: 25,000 to 35,000 total tokens per report; actual 31,065 per included report (341,721 / 11); output per included report 11,916. The estimate ignored the 84-PMID inclusion step (about a third of the run: 52 exclusions with reasons, 20 closed papers, 1 blocked) which is a fixed cost, so the cost per report extracted overstates the marginal cost of one more report. Sum of the two deepening-round delegates: output 299,469; total 765,632.

## Budget figure for the operator decision page (IT, 2026-11-17; basis stated)
Basis: DELEGATES ONLY (eight delegate runs of the evening: I2 extraction with its addendum pass, D5b tranche 1, tonic dossiers, WO-12/WO-25/WO-06 dossiers, contrast-set builder, contrast-set second reader, three-paper dossiers; sessions, Advisor runs and HE/SCI delegates are NOT included), read from the subagent transcripts with session_model_census.py and the harness totals: output 544,509 tokens; total subagent tokens 1,455,569; cache reads (context re-read, not new work) not added. Unit 1, per delivered package (7 packages, the two contrast-set runs counted as one pilot): output 77,787, total 207,938. Unit 2, per paper read in full (36: 14 held reports in the I2 extraction, 11 D5b reports, 5 tonic papers, 3 pharmacology papers, 3 target papers; the 11 abstract-only items excluded): output 15,125, total 40,433. Unit 3, per consumed result in DREAM-3 and DREAM-3b not computed as a rate: consumption status changes within hours and the two DREAM files list 20 results with different statuses (consumed, repaired, pending, not consumable) that I did not reduce to one count.
